chunk: Kaitlin Soto was born on February 4, 2001, in Quebec, Canada. Growing up in a family of artists, she was exposed to various creative outlets from a young age. Her parents, both passionate about pottery and scrapbooking, encouraged her to explore her own creative interests. Kaitlin's agreeable nature and high openness to experience led her to try her hand at various hobbies, eventually settling on pottery and scrapbooking as her favorite pastimes.
